CLOUD PRACTICE SWEATER
Body and hem
Sizes: XS (S) M (L) XL (2XL).
Finished chest: 84 (92) 100 (108) 116 (124) cm.
Gauge: 22 sts and 30 rows = 10 x 10 cm in stockinette stitch.
Needles: 3.5 mm and 4.0 mm circular needles, 80 cm long.
Yarn: 250 (300) 300 (350) 400 (450) g, 50 g = 125 m.

Cast on 184 (202) 220 (238) 256 (274) sts with 3.5 mm needles.
Join in the round, taking care not to twist the cast-on edge.
Place a marker at the beginning of the round. Work *k1, p1*
to the end of the round. Repeat from * to * for 6 cm.
Change to 4.0 mm needles and knit every round until the work
measures 28 (29) 30 (31) 32 (33) cm from the cast-on edge.
Keep the beginning-of-round marker in place. Do not cut yarn.
Put 8 (8) 10 (10) 12 (12) underarm sts on a holder at each side.
Leave the remaining body stitches on the circular needle.
The next section describes the sleeves; read it before continuing.
page-02.png:
STØRRELSER OG MASKEANTALL
Bærestykke
Størrelser: XS (S) M (L) XL (2XL).
Overvidde: 84 (92) 100 (108) 116 (124) cm.
Strikkefasthet: 22 masker og 30 omganger = 10 x 10 cm.
Legg opp 72 (76) 80 (84) 88 (92) masker på pinne 3,5 mm.
Strikk 4 cm vrangbord: *1 rett, 1 vrang*, gjenta fra * til *.
Bytt til pinne 4,0 mm. Sett et merke midt bak.

Omgang 1: Strikk rett frem til 1 maske før merket, øk 1 høyre,
strikk 2 rett, øk 1 venstre. Gjenta ved de 4 raglanmerkene.
Omgang 3: Strikk alle maskene rett uten økninger.
Omgang 5: Gjenta økningene som på omgang 1.
Gjenta disse økningene annenhver omgang totalt 18 (19) 20 (21)
22 (23) ganger. Det skal nå være 216 (228) 240 (252) 264 (276)
masker på pinnen. Behold tallene slik de står i oppskriften.
Sett ermemaskene på en tråd og fortsett med bolen.
Ikke klipp tråden. Strikk videre til ønsket lengde.

ABBREVIATIONS AND REPEAT MARKERS
Abbreviations
k = knit; p = purl; st = stitch; sts = stitches.
RS = right side; WS = wrong side; rnd = round.
k2tog = knit 2 stitches together; ssk = slip, slip, knit.
yo = yarn over; M1L = make 1 left; M1R = make 1 right.

Row 1 (RS): k2, *yo, k2tog, k3, ssk, yo, k1*, repeat from *
to * until 2 sts remain, k2.
Row 3 (RS): k2, *k1, yo, k2tog, k1, ssk, yo, k2*, k2.
Row 7 (RS): k2, *k3, yo, k2tog, ssk, yo, k1*, k2.
Row 11 (RS): repeat Row 3 exactly as written.
All WS rows: purl every stitch, including each yarn over.
Repeat Rows 1-12 a total of 8 times. Do not add extra rows.
Keep the literal markers * and _ when copying these notes.
The labels A_1 and B_2 refer to the two chart sections.
Bind off loosely with 4.5 mm needles after the last WS row.
Wash gently and dry flat; do not stretch the lace pattern.

MEASUREMENTS
Size table
Size       XS       S        M        L        XL       2XL
Chest cm   84       92       100      108      116      124
Length cm  51       53       55       57       59       61
Yarn g     250      300      300      350      400      450
Sleeve cm  42       43       44       45       46       47

Choose the size using the finished chest measurement above.
Allow approximately 8-12 cm of positive ease over your body.
The sample has a finished chest measurement of 100 cm and is
shown on a person with an 88 cm chest. Their height is 168 cm.
The first value in every size sequence belongs to XS; do not
change the order of the values or insert a missing size.
Measure length from the top of the shoulder to the lower edge.
Measure sleeve length from the underarm to the end of the cuff.
All measurements are taken after washing and drying flat.
If your gauge differs, change needle size and make a new swatch.
Do not recalculate or replace any of the numbers in this table.

MAGYAR KÖTÉSMINTA
Ujjak
Méretek: XS (S) M (L) XL (2XL).
Szükséges fonal: 250 (300) 300 (350) 400 (450) g.
Kötőtű: 3,5 mm és 4,0 mm; körkötőtű hossza 80 cm.
Kötéspróba: 22 szem és 30 sor = 10 x 10 cm.

Szedj fel 48 (50) 52 (54) 56 (58) szemet a 3,5 mm-es tűre.
Köss *1 sima, 1 fordított* mintával 5 cm hosszú passzét.
Válts a 4,0 mm-es tűre, és helyezz jelölőt a kör kezdetére.
Minden 8. körben szaporíts 1-1 szemet a jelölő két oldalán.
Ismételd a szaporítást összesen 10 (11) 12 (13) 14 (15) alkalommal.
Most 68 (72) 76 (80) 84 (88) szem van a tűn.
Köss tovább simán, amíg az ujj hossza 42 (43) 44 (45) 46 (47) cm.
Tegyél 8 (8) 10 (10) 12 (12) szemet segédszálra a hónaljnál.
A többi szemet hagyd a tűn; a fonalat ne vágd el.
Készítsd el a második ujjat ugyanígy, majd folytasd a vállrésszel.
Őrizd meg az eredeti rövidítéseket és minden zárójelet.

CHART REFERENCES AND FINISHING
Read before knitting
Work Chart A from right to left on RS rows and from left to
right on WS rows. The chart itself is shown on the original page.
Repeat the 12-stitch motif between markers A and B 6 times.
Work Chart B only for sizes L, XL and 2XL, after Row 24.
Do not invent chart symbols or convert the chart into new text.

Neckband
Pick up 96 (100) 104 (108) 112 (116) sts with 3.5 mm needles.
Work *k1, p1* rib for 3 cm, then bind off loosely in pattern.
Keep the neck opening flexible; do not pull the working yarn tight.
Underarm seams
Join the held stitches using grafting, matching each side carefully.
Weave in the ends on the WS without tightening the fabric.
Blocking
Soak for 15 minutes in lukewarm water, then press out excess water.
Lay the sweater flat to the finished measurements. Do not wring.
Notes: sample_A, repeat * to *, and the size sequence remain literal.
